Inevitable and unavoidable. Things are exactly as they have to be, no more or less. There is never a gap between what we think should happen and the way it actually does happen. We may resist this understanding for years with all kinds of strategies: attempts at control; intellectual rationalizations about how things could have been different if only... But eventually, sooner or later (it's a matter of timing), we surrender to the recognition that nothing is missing. We are what and where we ne

There is no need to look anywhere else. We have been given everything that we require for the purposes of our unfolding, and even this 'givenness' can be seen as just another aspect of ourselves - an expression in order to experience itself.
​And yet... it is not a question of believing or disbelieving any specific idea about the nature of reality, including this one! It comes down simply to how we are experiencing every moment without exception: Are we looking outward and engaging with the dra

.There is only one way to find out: by being here as fully and clearly as possible, with an open heart (not a blind eye) for whatever arises in each moment without exception - no matter how painful or difficult it may be at times...

The observer observes itself observing. There is no boundary between the observer and the observed. All boundaries dissolve. Only pure generation remains, generating itself endlessly, ceaselessly creating — even as it destroys the creations of its own creation. The creator creates, then observes a new birth through destruction of that which was created in order to generate anew and again observe the process throughout eternity.
